name: adk-git
description: Writes commit messages and pull request descriptions for the adk-python repository: Conventional Commits types and scopes, subject lines that say why a change was made, and the linked-issue and testing-plan sections the PR template requires. Use when writing or rewording a commit message, squashing commits before a pull request, drafting a PR description, or checking that a change is shaped to land. Don't use for generic git mechanics such as rebasing, resolving conflicts, cherry-picking, or branch surgery; those need no skill. Don't use to judge the content of a change (use adk-review) or for code style and naming (use adk-style).
